Hatzic offers exceptional lakefront lifestyle on Hatzic Lake with water access, recreational paradise, and genuine small-community atmosphere. This scenic Mission neighbourhood attracts families and retirees seeking waterfront properties from seasonal cottages to year-round homes, many featuring private docks, lake views, and the outdoor lifestyle that defines the area. Residents love swimming, fishing, kayaking, and water sports literally at their doorstep during summer, plus hiking and nature activities year-round in surrounding areas.

The community maintains strong connections with annual events, active community hall programs, and neighbours who genuinely look out for each other. Despite the lakeside setting, Mission's shopping, schools, and services are reasonable drives away via Dewdney Trunk Road. Properties offer outstanding value compared to other Lower Mainland waterfront communities, with larger lots and established character. Hatzic's natural beauty and recreation focus make it perfect for active families or retirees prioritizing outdoor living. Ready to explore Hatzic lakefront?
